newsitem.title: USA: Mellon says cannot intervene in WHX strike.
newsitem.headline: Mellon says cannot intervene in WHX strike.

text.p: Mellon Bank Corp said Monday it and its subsidiaries do not own shares in WHX Corp and as such cannot intervene in a strike by members of the United Steelworkers of America against WHX's Wheeling- Pittsburgh Steel.

In a statement, Mellon said that shares it and its subsidiaries hold in WHX are held as a fiduciary on behalf of clients. As such, it said it has no legal rights to the shares and is limited on actions it can take regarding WHX.

Mellon was responding to an announcement by the union that it would hold a press conference today to announce a series of actions directed at the bank, chiefly to convince Mellon to intervene in the steel workers' nine-month-old strike against Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel.
Mellon said it recognizes the harm that a prolonged strike can do to workers, their families and their communities and urged both parties in the strike to work toward prompt resolution of the matter.
"However, the distortion of the facts regarding Mellon's holdings in WHX Corp is not constructive and does not contribute to resolving the dispute," it said.
